name: XAS Facility
abstract: Schema defining properties for documenting the facility (a schema:Place typed with the NeXus NXsource base class, e.g. a synchrotron/storage-ring facility) where X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) data is acquired. Defines properties: @type, schema:additionalType, schema:identifier, schema:name, schema:additionalProperty. Uses building blocks: additionalProperty (schemaorgProperties), identifier (schemaorgProperties).
